en: For the conductor, with stringed music; a maskil of Dovid.

he: בְּבֹ֣א הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
en: When the Zifim came and said to Shaul: 'Is not Dovid hiding with us?'
Elokim, by Your name save me; and by Your might judge me.
Elokim, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

he: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים ׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
en: For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless ones seek my soul; they have not set Elokim before them. Selah.

he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
en: Behold, Elokim is my helper; Adonai is among those who uphold my soul.
He shall return the evil upon my watchers; in Your truth, destroy them.
With a freewill offering I shall sacrifice to You; I shall thank Your name, Havayah, for it is good.

he: כִּ֣י מִכׇּל־צָ֭רָה הִצִּילָ֑נִי וּ֝בְאֹיְבַ֗י רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃ {פ}
en: For from every trouble He has delivered me; and upon my enemies my eye has looked.
